common.errorBody: Please try again. If it keeps happening, tell your manager.
common.notFoundBody: This page does not exist, or your role cannot open it.

auth.signInIntro: Use the email and password your manager gave you.
auth.invalidCredentials: That email or password is not right. Check them and try again.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Wait one minute, then try again.
auth.genericError: Could not sign in. Check your connection and try again.
auth.twoFactorIntro: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for Yanmu Nursery.
auth.invalidCode: That code did not work. Codes change every 30 seconds; try the newest one.
auth.demoIntro: This is a preview with made-up data. Tap a role to sign in as that person. Password for all:

mfa.setupIntro: Your role can see money and personal data, so signing in needs your password and a code from your phone.
mfa.step1: Install an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
mfa.step2: Confirm your password to create your personal code.
mfa.step3: Scan the square code with the app, then type the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrAlt: Square code to scan with your authenticator app
mfa.manualKey: Can't scan? Type this key into the app:
mfa.backupIntro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Write them down and keep them somewhere safe.

sections.my-room: The children in your room today.
sections.roll-call: Mark who is here, one tap per child.
sections.incident: Log an incident in four quick fields.

children.noBranch: You do not have a branch yet. Ask the owner to give you a role in a branch.
children.occupancyFull: The branch is at its licence limit. The next child needs the owner's approval.
children.search: Search by name, child number or parent's phone
children.count: {count, plural, =0 {No children} one {# child} other {# children}}

form.title: Add child
form.help: Adding to {branch}. Fields marked as required must be filled in.
form.waitlistPrefill: Filled in from the waitlist. Check the details and complete the rest.
form.familyExistingHelp: The new child joins this family's account and invoices.
form.familyNameHint: For example: Hassan family. Leave empty to use the first parent's name.
form.stepGuardians: 3. Parents and who may pick up
form.guardiansExistingHelp: Parents already on the family account are added automatically. Add anyone new here.
form.addSecond: Add a second parent or guardian
form.consentHelp: Tick each form the parent has signed. The records form is required; without it the child shows a red flag.
form.consentScan: Signed form (photo or PDF, up to 5 MB, optional)
form.medicalHelp: Only the branch manager and the child's teachers can read these.
form.bandHint: {room} is for {band}, and the child's age fits another room.
form.duplicateTitle: This child may already be registered
form.duplicateNameAndBirth: Same name and date of birth: {name} ({number})
form.saveAnyway: It is a different child, save anyway
form.overCapacityBody: The licence allows {licensed} children. If you continue, this child is saved and sent to the owner, who decides. Write why the child should be accepted.
form.sendForApproval: Save and send to the owner
form.savedPending: Saved. The child is waiting for the owner's approval.

detail.medicalRestricted: Medical notes are private to the branch manager and the child's teachers.
detail.medicalHidden: Medical notes are private. To open them, write why. Your name and reason are recorded.
detail.breakGlassLogged: Opened. Your reason has been recorded in the audit log.
detail.consentMissing: No signed records consent. Ask the parent to sign the form, then record it below.
detail.bandReasonLabel: Reason, if the room is for another age
detail.bandReasonHint: Needed only when the child's age fits a different room.
detail.transferHelp: The manager of the other branch accepts the child and picks the room. The child keeps the same record and history.
detail.transferPending: Transfer to {branch} is waiting for that branch to accept.
detail.overCapacityPending: This child is waiting for the owner's approval because the branch is at its licence limit.
detail.withdrawHelp: Choose the last day and the reason. Refunds of unused days will come with the money screens.

approvalsPage.waitingBranch: Waiting for the other branch's manager.

importPage.title: Import children from Excel
importPage.help: For moving children from your current spreadsheets. Nothing is saved until you press Import, and an import can be undone.
importPage.step1: Download the template for this branch.
importPage.step2: Fill in one row per child. Brothers and sisters share the same family number.
importPage.step3: Upload the file and press Check. Problems are listed by row.
importPage.step4: When there are no problems, press Import.
importPage.errorsTitle: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} to fix. Nothing has been imported.
importPage.fixAndRetry: Fix these rows in the file, then upload it again.
importPage.ready: {count, plural, one {# child is} other {# children are}} ready to import
importPage.importButton: Import {count, plural, one {# child} other {# children}}
importPage.done: Imported {count, plural, one {# child} other {# children}}.

errors.futureBirth: the date of birth is in the future
errors.duplicateInFile: the same child appears twice in the file
errors.familyMismatch: same family number as an earlier row, but no parent phone in common
errors.overCapacity: the branch would go over its licence limit; add these children one by one so the owner can approve
errors.badFile: The file could not be read. Upload the .xlsx template, up to 5 MB.
errors.badTemplate: The first row does not have the template's column names. Download the template and copy your data into it.
errors.noRows: The file has no children in it.
errors.changed: Something changed since you checked the file. Check it again.

errors.invalid: Some details are missing or not valid. Check the form.
errors.notFound: There is no current enrollment to change.

errors.badPhone: Check the mobile number: 11 digits starting 01.
errors.badFile: Files must be a photo or PDF, up to 5 MB.
errors.guardianRequired: Add at least one parent or guardian.
errors.age_out_of_range: Children can join from 3 months old and up to 4½ years.
errors.band_reason_required: Write why the child goes into a room for another age.
errors.over_capacity: The branch is at its licence limit. The child needs the owner's approval.
errors.not_pending: This request has already been decided.
errors.own_request: You cannot approve your own request.
errors.reason_required: Please write a reason (at least 5 letters).
errors.changed_since_import: This import cannot be undone: some of its children were changed by hand since (moved, re-enrolled or given a brother or sister).
